transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you in today?

I came in because, for the past few weeks, I’ve just had this heavy sadness on me most of the day. It’s like a pressure I can’t really shake. Even when I’m at work smiling and talking to patients, inside I feel like I’m barely holding it together.
Have you noticed any change in your interest or pleasure in doing things you usually enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with loved ones?

Yeah, definitely. After my shifts I used to paint, or go to yoga, sometimes salsa, just to decompress. Lately I just go home and sit on the couch. I ignore texts too, even from people I care about, because none of it feels worth the effort right now.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Yeah, my appetite’s definitely been off. I know I should be eating regular meals, but most days food just doesn’t sound good. I’ll get halfway through a clinic shift and realize I’ve only had coffee or some crackers all day.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight recently, like losing or gaining a lot without trying?

I haven’t really weighed myself, so I’m not sure how much it’s changed. But I’m definitely eating less. Most days food just doesn’t sound good, and I’ll realize halfway through a shift that I’ve only had coffee or crackers.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, like trouble falling asleep, waking up during the night, or waking up earlier than usual?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been paying close attention to my sleep, honestly. Nothing specific comes to mind, like I can’t say for sure that I’m waking up early or anything.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or worthless lately, like you’re a burden or that you’ve let people down?

I’m not sure. I don’t think I’ve been feeling worthless exactly, or like a burden. I mean, I have moments where I feel bad that I’m not doing as much as I should, but I wouldn’t say it’s been a major thing.
Have you noticed any trouble focusing or thinking clearly lately, like it’s harder to make decisions or stay focused at work?

Yeah, I have noticed that. At work I keep having to reread medication orders or wound-care notes because my brain just feels foggy. And decisions I’d normally make without thinking are making me freeze up and second-guess myself.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or that you can't sit still and feel restless?

Yeah… more slowed down than restless. Everything feels like it takes extra effort, like I’m moving through syrup. Even simple things at the clinic, like getting wound supplies together or finishing my charting, are taking me noticeably longer than they should.
Have you experienced days where you felt no interest or pleasure in anything at all, even things you usually enjoy?

Yeah. After my shifts, I used to paint or go to yoga, sometimes salsa, just to unwind. Lately I just go home and sit on the couch. I’ll see texts come in and ignore them because none of it feels worth the effort.
Can you tell me how long you’ve been feeling this way? Have these feelings of sadness and loss of interest lasted for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?
Yeah… it’s been about three weeks now. It started not long after I found out I was pregnant. And yes, it’s been there most of the day, pretty much every day.
Have you ever felt like life isn’t worth living or had thoughts about ending your life?
Yes… not like I have a plan to hurt myself. But I’ve been having thoughts like, I wish I just wouldn’t wake up. That scared me enough that I finally said something at my prenatal appointment.
Can you describe how your mood changes throughout the day — do you ever feel even a little better during certain moments, like when something good happens, or does it feel the same all the time?

It doesn’t really lift much. It’s like this heavy sadness is sitting on me almost all day. Even at work, I can smile and talk to patients like I’m okay, but inside I feel like I’m barely holding it together. Sometimes I can get through a moment, but I don’t feel actually better.
Has this sadness or low mood started during pregnancy or within four weeks after giving birth?
Yes, it started during the pregnancy. It’s been about three weeks, pretty much since shortly after I found out I was pregnant.
Have you experienced any strange thoughts or perceptions lately, like hearing voices or believing things that others might not, especially related to your feelings of sadness or pregnancy?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t been hearing voices or seeing things. And I don’t believe anything unusual about the pregnancy… I just feel really down and overwhelmed.
